name: AliensAreHere
description: Aliens Are Here is a UFO and UAP disclosure platform on Base, publishing news, podcasts and community discussion to grow the disclosure community and raise public awareness. AAH is its ERC-20 token, intended as payment for platform services and as community rewards. 100,000 minted at launch against a 5,000,000 hard cap, with team allocations time-locked in a public vesting contract.
